text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Members of Parliament are making undue use of travel grants, with only five MPs not claiming the allowance.
- A decision on the feasibility of the HAIB Copper Project is expected by the middle of December, according to the latest quarterly report of Great Fitzroy Mines of Australia.
- Delinking the Namibian dollar from the South Afrivca rand is not a viable option in the short-term, according to a panel discussion by the Namibian Economic Group in Windhoek.
- The Commission for Social Justice is holding a joint seminar with the International Labour Organisation on the future of social security of all Namibians.
